name: Monster Trainer Monster Scout
body:
Monster scouts are elite warriors with special training that allows them to fight alongside their monster in battle. A scout’s monsters are typically more physical in nature than those raised by other trainers, but they lack the ability to cast more powerful spells.

Scouts are divided into two camps; reeves and sentinels. Reeves are sanctioned by the king to protect his lands. Most reeves wear the heavy armor all scouts are proficient with, and many of them worship one or more of the gods of their world. Sentinels are more commonly seen as mercenaries or sell swords. They put their faith in nature and wear light or medium armor to make the most use of their Dexterity.

Hit Dice and Base Attack

A monster scout’s monster trainer Hit Die is a d10, and her base attack bonus is equal to her monster trainer level. This alters the monster trainer’s Hit Dice and base attack.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A monster scout is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, with all types of armor and with shields (except tower shields). She suffers no arcane spell failure for casting monster trainer spells while wearing armor or using a shield. This alters the monster trainer’s proficiencies.

Spells per Day

A monster scout gains spells per day as a ranger of her monster trainer level, which means her active monster does not grant the scout 1st-level spells until she is 4th level, and she cannot cast 5th-level or higher trainer spells, even if a monster would grant them to her. She can still cast cantrips granted by her active monster at will. This alters the monster trainer’s spellcasting and spells per day.

Detection (Su)

As a standard action, a scout can detect monsters. This ability functions as the detect animals or plants spell, but the scout can detect any monster that shares a type with her active monster.

Sidekick

The scout gains Sidekick as a bonus feat at 1st level. This replaces eschew materials.

Scout’s Faction

Each monster scout must choose to be either a reeve or a sentinel. This choice can’t be changed later.

Reeve (Su): At 2nd level, and every 3 levels thereafter, a reeve gains the smite monster trainer perk. If she chooses the improved favored enemy perk, the reeve treats monsters of the chosen type the same as a paladin would treat an undead.

Sentinel (Ex): At 1st level, a sentinel gains favored enemy, as the ranger class feature. She still gains additional favored enemies at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, and her bonuses improve as they would for a ranger of her monster trainer level. If she chooses the improved favored enemy perk, the sentinel gains a favored terrain of her choice instead.

This ability replaces the trainer’s normal favored enemy and alters the improved favored enemy perk.

The following trainer perks complement the scout archetype: Animal companion, armored companion, natural armor, run with me, side-by-side, tough companion, and warrior companion.
